summary: Nuran Wireless filed a Form 6-K with an attached press release dated September 1, 2026, announcing a strategic plan to expand its Network-as-a-Service platform into edge AI and local compute infrastructure at its existing rural connectivity sites in Africa. No specific transaction, pricing, or deal terms were disclosed. The company intends to add modular edge compute nodes at selected sites, initially for caching and later for AI-driven services. This is a business strategy announcement, not a special-situation corporate event. What to watch: operational execution of pilots and revenue impact, but no risk-arb angle.
